versions.content: Value of priority to traffic class assignment should respect configured limitations Status: DRAFT The value of EthSwtPortPriorityToTrafficClassAssignmentPriority within an EthSwtPortPriorityToTrafficClassAssignment shall not exceed the configured value range from 0 to EthSwtUsedInternalPriorityUpperValue at the same Ethernet switch
